step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word. If you have already downloaded the document from Salesforce or another location, open the document in Word. Otherwise, choose a blank document.
Go to Insert > My Add-ins > Apttus X-Author.
Complete this action.Log in to X-Author Contracts.

Complete this action.(Document currently open in Word) The document is automatically checked out and locked by you (you will see a message). Note: if the document is already checked out by another user, you will not be able to work with the document until it is checked in or the lock is released. See Locking and Unlocking Documents for more information.
Complete this action.(No Document open) Click on the List Agreements icon to switch to a tab view of all agreement records you have permission to access.

Complete this action.(No Document open) Scroll through the list of agreements or use the Search tool at the top to search for your agreement record by keyword(s). Click the icon to view additional details about the agreement.
Complete this action.(No Document open) Click the List Documents button to the right of the agreement record name to display a list of document versions attached to that record.
Complete this action.(No Document open) Click the Download Document button to the right of the agreement version you want to work with. The Document Version is downloaded to your computer.
Open the downloaded document in Word.
You will see the message "Document is locked by you." All menu options are enabled.
